title: Host-observed source changes attach to whichever item a multi-claim session last focused, not to the work the change belongs to
outcome: Host-observed source changes attach to whichever item a multi-claim session last focused, not to the work the change belongs to
acceptance: A session that holds several claims can keep each host-observed source change off items it did not change, or Engram documents why it cannot and what the agent must do
A test reproduces the misattribution before the fix: a targeted note moves focus to one claim, and a later source-changing turn opens an obligation on it

An acceptance evaluation in flight is not invalidated by a source change the evaluator already saw: a source_changed observation whose source revision equals the evaluation's declared source fingerprint on the same root does not refuse, and the evaluator can refresh its basis when no new entry is a source change it did not see
The stale-evaluation refusal names its class: a host-observed check after the basis says to refresh and resubmit, and an unseen source change says the evaluation is void and must be requested again

completion.summary: A multi-claim session's host-observed source changes no longer drift onto items it did not change. A non-holder's note, gate or evaluate leaves focus alone, so the next turn stays bound to the session's own claim. docs/features/acceptance-evaluation.md "Turns, focus and evaluation timing" explains why Engram cannot split a turn's change by claim, and what to do: switch with `claim REF` at a turn boundary, and request evaluations at a turn boundary. An evaluation is no longer voided by a source change to the revision it declared it judged (source_fingerprint), nor by the obligation that change opened. A moved basis now refuses with its class: acceptance_evaluation_resubmit after a check, acceptance_evaluation_void after an unseen source change. The refusal message and the details carry the same remedy text. Tests in basis_moves.rs and observations.rs reproduce the misattribution and pin each behaviour. Landed as 24634aa (pushed) and installed as build 7094b7cc6743; both stores reported ready. TermAl was told about the new codes and the focus change. Independent evaluation ca463b4a passed all 4 criteria.
